newsitem.title: USA: Hub Group boosts its stake in affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Hub Group boosts its stake in affiliate.

text.p: Hub Group Inc said Tuesday it exercised an option to acquire about 44 percent of Hub Distribution Services for $1.5 million in cash, raising its holdings to 65 percent of the affiliate's shares.
The president of Hub Distribution Services, which provides logistics services to customers with specialized needs, owns the remaining 35-percent stake, Hub Group said.
Hub Group provides transportation services through a network of 34 offices in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
Its shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 26-3/8.
